title: Personal synthetic batch manifest preview input
description: Read-only calculation after owner, Project Maintainer and Origin authorization. No batch, request, attempt, fee reservation or model call is created. Strict JSON, duplicate keys and trailing content are rejected; the complete HTTP body is limited to 8192 bytes.

templateRequestIds.description: Existing immutable Agent request templates from the authorized Project only. Server sorts IDs and calculates the manifest; neither raw input nor citation content is returned.
